question: The famous Hindi novel ‘Gaban’ is written by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Munshi Premchand**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Munshi Premchand has written the famous Hindi Novel "Godan".
 
• It was first published in 1936 and is considered one of the greatest Hindi novels of modern Indian literature.
 
• Premchand was a pioneer of Hindi and Urdu social fiction.
 
• It highlights the struggle between the peasant and the money-lender backed by various forces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
